source.description: Automatisch umgewandelt aus der MusicXML-Datei „Antonio-Scandello-No-9-Christ-ist-erstanden.mxl“ der CPDL-Seite „Christ ist erstanden (Antonio Scandello)“ mit tools/liedquellen/cpdl_import.py. Nicht gegen die Vorlage geprüft. Hinweis der Ausgabe: A semi-diplomatic edition: Modern clefs but original key and note-values. Fictas are added though conservatively as there are several places where more could have been added following the practice of that time. Score and parts are included.
